item.title: Osananajimi no Kanojo ga, Giri no Ani to Futari de Kurashi Hajimeta Ken ni Tsuite
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: T-Rance
  • 発売日: 2011-12-19
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: 幼馴染の彼女が、義理の兄と2人で暮らし始めた件について
  • 英語名: Osananajimi no Kanojo ga, Giri no Ani to Futari de Kurashi Hajimeta Ken ni Tsuite

别名

  • The Story of Childhood Friend Eri

あらすじ

Eri was a bright and popular girl with style and friends.

This story is about her.

Eri’s neighbor was a boy two years older named Shogo.

They were good friends and over time became lovers.

One day Eri’s parent got remarried, and she gained a new brother, Masao.

item.title: Uchi no Tsuma ga Hibi Kirei ni Natte Iku Ken ni Tsuite
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: T-Rance
  • 発売日: 2011-10-15
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: うちの妻が日々綺麗になっていく件について
  • 英語名: Uchi no Tsuma ga Hibi Kirei ni Natte Iku Ken ni Tsuite

あらすじ

A married woman (protagonist) tells her personal story of how she began sleeping with a wealthy young lover to pay her husband’s debts… but over time, somehow, she fell more deeply in love with him.

An adventure style story, starring Eri (the wife), her lover, and her husband.
